releaseNotes:
- Long-running image generation now stays connected to active provider jobs instead of stopping while results are still on the way
- Character portrait production now resolves its packaged runtime dependencies reliably after installation
- Existing books now receive current Agent Skills reliably when the authenticated Skill cache refreshes
- CG video guidance now stays separate from canonical story sources, keeping project content clean while prompts remain available to the Agent
- Published stories now retain required opening scripts and playable streaming media addresses
releaseNotesZh:
- 长时间图片生成现会持续跟进仍在运行的供应商任务，不会在结果尚未返回时误判停止
- 角色立绘生产现可在安装后的应用中可靠加载所需运行依赖
- 已存在的书籍现可在认证 Skill 缓存刷新后可靠获得最新的 Agent Skill
- CG 视频指导现与权威故事正文保持分离，在 Agent 可正常使用提示的同时避免污染项目内容
- 已发布作品现会完整保留必要的开场脚本与可播放的流媒体地址
